sentences.text: we speak very slowly. We use easy English. We repeat words and ideas many times. Today,
we travel to Africa. We go to Morocco. Our city today is Esauira. Esauira is calm. Esauira
is fresh. Esauira is full of wind, sea and history. Please relax. Please listen slowly.
Let's begin our journey together. Part 2. Morocco and Africa. Morocco is a country
in North Africa. It is close to Europe. Morocco has deserts. Morocco has mountains.
Morocco has the ocean. Many people know Marrakesh. Many people know Casablanca. But
today, we visit Esauira. Esauira is smaller. Esauira is quieter. Hash part 3. Where is
Esauira? Esauira is on the Atlantic Ocean. It is on the west coast of Morocco. The city
is next to the sea. You can hear the waves. Wind is very important here. The wind is
strong and cool. Esauira feels open. The sea is always close. Part 4. Weather and
climate. Esauira has a mild climate. It is not very hot. It is not very cold. The wind
cools the city. Even in summer, it feels fresh. People wear light clothes. Life feels
comfortable. The weather helps people relax. Part 5. A city with history. Esauira has a
long history. Many people lived here before. Traders came by sea. Different
cultures met here. You can see history in the walls. You can see history in the
streets. The past is part of daily life. Part 6. The old Medina. Esauira has an old
city called the Medina. The Medina is protected by walls. The streets are small.
The buildings are white and blue. People walk slowly. Shops are small and simple.
The Medina feels calm and artistic. Part 7. The sea and the port. The sea is very
important in Esauira. There is a small fishing port. Boats are blue. Fishermen
work every day. You can see fish. You can see birds. The sea gives food. The sea
gives life. Part 8. Art and Music. Esauira is a city of art. Many artists live here.
There are art shops. There are music sounds. The city is famous for music
and the city special. Art brings people together. Part 9. Daily Life in Esauira.
Daily Life in Esauira is slow. People wake up calmly. They work in shops. They fish.
They talk with neighbors. In the afternoon people rest. In the evening people walk by
the sea. Life feels peaceful and simple. Part 10. Food in Esauira. Food in Esauira is
fresh. Seafood is very popular. People eat fish. People eat bread and vegetables.
Meals are simple. Meals are shared. Food brings people close. Eating is a social
nature is everywhere in Esauira. You see the sea. You feel the wind. The sound of waves
is calming. The sky feels wide. People come here to rest. People come here to think.
The city feels free and open. Part 12. Spirit of Esauira and Goodbye. Esauira is a city
of the ocean, the wind, art, music and slow life. It is not busy. It is not loud. It is peaceful.
